item.title: Beijing Sinotau International Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd. (09941)
item.description: Biotech firm Sinotau is now taking subscriptions at HK$52.00-68.00, closing 19 November and listing 24 November, with grey-market trading on 23 November; it focuses on radiopharmaceutical diagnostics and therapies. Oversubscribed about 3801.34 times.
